_about: The firm's treaty table (SOP v2 P-TRT-*): one row per country and kind of income the firm has checked. A row says who may tax it: UK_ONLY (no foreign tax credit: the client reclaims the foreign tax there, R-SA106-02) or BOTH with the most the source country may take (max_rate) for the credit. A country and kind not in the table is an accountant decision: look the treaty up before the credit is given. Countries by HMRC's 3-letter codes (SA106 notes). Foreign tax years for time-apportioning (R-SA106-05). Rows for New Zealand, France, Australia, USA, Ireland, India, South Africa and the UAE read from each treaty's text on GOV.UK (5 Nov 2026); India's dividends and France's government pensions are left to a decision (the article needs reading case by case).
